name: pospilot
author: PosPilot
description: Pharmacy POS — React client + Express/better-sqlite3 server + Electron shell

scripts.rebuild:electron: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const target=path.join(process.cwd(),'node_modules','better-sqlite3','build','Release'); fs.rmSync(target,{recursive:true,force:true});" && npm rebuild better-sqlite3 --build-from-source --runtime=electron --target=32.0.0 --dist-url=https://electronjs.org/headers --force
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -k -n server,client,electron -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && npm run start --workspace electron"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n server,client,electron -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && npm run dev:electron"
